strings.TMI_visionary_enclave_desc: The Institute, above all, is an enclave founded to follow the goal of a better world through science and reason. The resources of Chelyabinsk have been put to use once more, as means of developing and manufacturing goods which may be used to reclaim the wastes, and restore a semblance of civilization. Under Director Kardashev, the Institute is focusing on a way to chemically reclaim the poisoned soil and water of Russia - and, with the last major concentration of scientists and visionaries in Russia, it may very well be that the Institute is the last hope for a livable Russia.
strings.TMI_the_cutting_edge_desc: While the Institute's forces are small, the infrastructure of Chelyabinsk means that they are capable of equipping an army with capabilities that outstrip their size. With each soldier bearing their finest advances, it is guaranteed that the Institute, if challenged, shall not go quietly.
